# Canvas layer panel
 Layer order is persisted locally so that reopening a drawing keeps the sidebar arrangement.
 The browser entry is src/panel.ts; the editor supplies the root element and storage port.

export type Layer = { id: string; label: string };
 export type LayerStore = { saveOrder(ids: string[]): void };
